lead: A `Core\Db` statement member is declared twice under one symbol, and changing its arity means changing both rows.
body: `nvs_stdlib::db::registry` gives `query`, `queryAs`, `execute`, `executeMany` and `stream` a row on `CONNECTION` and one on `TRANSACTION` reaching the same body, so editing one leaves a helper declared at two arities — a runtime panic in `nvs_helper!`'s `args: [N]` check, not a build error. `grep -c 'name: "<member>"' crates/nvs-stdlib/src/db/registry.rs` and expect `2`; a `nv splice` "block appears 2 times" refusal is the same tell.
